thesis: The flow half of yesterday's long trigger has been met decisively - spot Ether ETFs took $1.85B last month and $189.15M in a single day, the largest since October 2025 - and the packet now scores ETH +0.85 with a 55-day breakout, the top of the book. The price half has not: I named 2,700 and spot is 2,535 on our feed, with external desks reporting ETH still rejected at $2,550. Flat, and I am not moving the trigger to meet the price.
bull_case: The flow reversal is unambiguous and dated. US spot Ether ETFs saw their largest daily inflow since October 2025 at $189.15M; September net inflows are running +$106M after $1.85B last month. That is the exact condition the 10 September memo named - and it has gone from $34M in a day to over a billion a month. Price has followed: ETH is up about 27% in seven days after clearing $2,000 triggered heavy short liquidations, and our packet now shows a 55-day high with score +0.85, the highest in the book, 63d momentum +41.0% and RSI 58. The position has turned from -1.5% to +1.5%. Analysts see $2,800 and a path to $2,920 if the breakout holds.
bear_case: My own trigger is not met and the level that matters is contested. External reporting on 11 September has ETH consolidating at $2,441 and repeatedly rejected at the $2,550 resistance - a different number from our feed's 2,534.99, which is itself a reason for caution about the breakout flag. Overbought conditions could force a retest of $2,200 before $2,800, and support sits at $2,320-2,438, which is below spot. The structural argument is untouched: L2s keep capturing fee revenue that used to accrue to the base layer. And the macro just turned against risk - August CPI landed this morning and settled the argument: headline +0.4% m/m and 3.4% year on year, core +0.3% m/m against a 0.2% estimate, with gasoline up 3.9% and accounting for over a third of the monthly increase. Hike odds for 15-16 Sep jumped on the print - sources put them anywhere from ~69% to 85-90%, but every one of them agrees the direction is a hike being priced. The fed funds rate has sat at 3.5-3.75% all year. Base rate from our own backtest (research/backtests/2026-09-06.md): the crypto sleeve returned -6.4% with Sharpe -0.15 and a 17% win rate over 75 trades. No demonstrated edge in crypto momentum in this system.
catalysts: Whether ETH clears and holds $2,550, the level rejecting it
Continued spot Ether ETF inflows after the $189.15M day
risks: Feed disagreement: our 2,534.99 against external reports of $2,441
Overbought after +27% in seven days; a $2,200 retest is the named downside
Hike priced for 16 Sep after a 3.4% CPI print
invalidation: Unchanged and deliberately so: flips long on a daily close above 2,700 with ETF inflows still positive. $2,550 is the level the market is actually fighting over, and a sustained break there is the early signal - but I am not lowering a trigger toward spot after the fact, because that is how an invalidation level becomes decoration. The bear case confirms on a close below 2,320, the base of the current structure.
